Appointment of Dushyant Gautam as Sikkim Governor sparks protests

Dushyant Gautam was appointed Governor of Sikkim, prompting protests by grieving parents of the Ankita Bhandari case; the protesting parents were removed from the demonstration, and Rahul wrote to the President requesting that the appointment be reconsidered. The appointment has drawn broader public questioning of Gautam’s suitability and his connection to the Ankita Bhandari case.
